verdict.rationale: Paychex documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0 that covers workers, state taxes, webhooks, complex check creation, recurring deductions and employee-data sync. Nothing in the pack claims or shows parity with the Flex UI. UI capabilities such as reporting dashboards, time-off approvals, AI compliance tools and Pre-check have no documented API equivalents, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt to verify coverage. Missing for 10: any stated or documented UI-to-API parity, API coverage of reporting, time-off, compliance and self-service features, a published machine-readable spec, and independent corroboration.
